caption:
Cup Noodles Museum in Ikeda: design a cup, make noodles, or just explore? 🍜

🎨 My CUPNOODLES Factory: design your own cup for ¥500, no booking, numbered tickets on the day
👩‍🍳 Chicken Ramen Factory: 70 minutes of real noodle-making, ¥1,200 for adults, reservation only
🏛️ Both full? The museum is free: the Instant Noodles Tunnel and the shed where Chicken Ramen was invented in 1958

Our pick: the ¥500 cup for most visitors; book the workshop only if you can commit to a session. Closed Tuesdays.
